integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof and standalone exact-rational checker; finite diagnostics are not infinite certification. Scientific publication priority is qualified; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary Gaussian result for equal trap/friction rates, three independent equal thermal noises, Couette drive and equal nonreciprocal hidden couplings. No claim for arbitrary transient states, zero hidden coupling, unequal temperatures, or shear at/above the stability threshold. The 2024 source provides the model and covariance moment equations; the informational classification is the new statement, with publication-priority risk from stronger unindexed implications.
title: Two distinct information-screening shear thresholds in a nonreciprocal Brownian trap
